## Proposal: January 15 Intake Deadline for H-1B Registrations

**Summary:** Starting this cap season, we send engagement letters and the intake questionnaire the week of December 7 and close registration intake on January 15. Anything after that we handle case by case.

**Why.** Last season (March 2026) we filed 14 registrations for 6 employer clients, and 9 of those 14 came in during the final week of February. That wasn't really on the clients. Our current process is to email the questionnaire whenever an employer asks for it, with no set date, so nobody had a deadline to work toward. One HR contact told me afterward she'd happily have sent everything in January if we'd asked. Most of the crunch came from our process, and we can fix that.

The crunch had a real cost. Rosa logged about 11 hours of overtime the week the window opened. And the late rush is where mistakes slip through. The registration itself is simple, but errors are expensive: a wrong or expired passport can mean an invalid selection. Last season a passport scan came in two days before the window, and it had expired in October. We caught it only because Rosa checked the dates. I'd rather not depend on catches like that.

**Why January 15 works.** HR teams are back from the holidays and their budgets are set. The $215 per-beneficiary registration fee is already in their Q1 planning, so we aren't asking them to find money early. We're giving them a clear date and enough lead time to meet it. I think clients will see this as better service.

**What would change:**

- Engagement letters and a one-page questionnaire go out the week of December 7
- Intake closes January 15
- Anything after January 15 is handled case by case, not refused
- Rosa owns the tracker and gets a clean six weeks to chase gaps, verify passport dates, and sort out issues before the window opens
- Attorney review happens on a steady schedule, not all in one week

**What I need from Thursday:** If Marcus is on board, we lock in the dates and I'll get the December letters drafted so they're ready to send the week of the 7th.
